facts.fact: Date Masamune commissioned the shrine and its construction lasted1604–1607.
The main hall is designated a National Treasure.
facts.excerpt: The shrine’s main hall is a National Treasure.

facts.fact: The principal decoration includes gold leaf, painted carvings and black-lacquered wood.
facts.excerpt: gold leaf and beautifully painted carvings

facts.fact: The usual approach has a steep stone stairway, a cobbled path and three torii gates.
facts.excerpt: The approach to the shrine is up a steep flight of stone steps to a cobbled path flanked by trees.

facts.fact: The shrine is northwest of the central city near the historical western gateway; it is not next door to Jozenji.
facts.excerpt: located to the northwest of the city of Sendai

title: City of Sendai — Osaki Hachimangu Shrine
